context: Asuka lectures on copyright and citing sources.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; academic vocabulary (著作/参照/疑問/賞/与える) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文では、著作の出典を必ず示します。
lines.en: In papers, always cite the source of works.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 参照した本も、書くんですか?
lines.en: Do I write the books I referenced too?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、参照した著作を、全て載せます。
lines.en: Yes, list every work you referenced.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一つ、疑問があるんですが。
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 疑問は、遠慮なく聞いて下さいね。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 良い論文には、賞が出るんですか?
lines.style: engaged adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 優れた著作には、賞が与えられます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 参照を大切に、書いてみます。
lines.style: resolved adult student voice, soft warm appreciative closing throughout
